title: Nahid on Kennedy Tops Off as Cladding Advances in Scarborough Junction
summary: Nahid on Kennedy has topped off at 12 storeys in Toronto’s Scarborough Junction neighbourhood, with cladding now covering most of the elevations. Designed by Wayne Long Architect and Option Architects for Nahid Corporation, the condominium development occupies the southeast corner of Kennedy Road and Corvette Avenue, less than a kilometre south of Eglinton Avenue.
